① Tap “Display over other apps” so full-screen reminders show even inside other apps

② Allow battery optimization exemption for this app

③ System settings → Apps → Muse: enable “Auto-start”

④ Set power policy to unrestricted:
· Xiaomi/Redmi: App info → Battery saver → No restrictions
· Huawei/Honor: Launch management → Manage manually, enable all three
· OPPO/vivo: Battery → Allow background activity

⑤ Lock this app in Recents so batch cleanup spares it

※ Android cannot reconstruct lock history after the service dies, so timing pauses with a health alert instead of fabricating progress.

※ “Force stop” kills the service and its alarm chain too; reopen the app to resume.
